simulator.note: Boots as the C3505 family (chips/c3505.py): its boot-ROM bootloader at offset 0x800 sets $sp to 0xBFE04000, unpacks the 8.3 MB maincode into RAM and starts it.  The application starts the SEE co-processor program ("M3505 SEE") at 0xA6000200, finds the internal S3505 demodulator via C3505.nim, drives the FD650K front panel on GPIO 107 / 108 (" O  ", " on ", "Stn ", "neAr", "nenu"), and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 "System Setup" OSD menu (12 GE commands, 146 unique colours) through the display engine at 0xB8006900.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 154 Combo firmware V1.30B0 PATCH (2019-03-05) for the H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo receiver on the ALi C3505 SoC.

Pairs the C3505's internal S3505 satellite demodulator with a terrestrial/cable COFDM front end, an FD650K front panel on SCL = GPIO 107, SDA = GPIO 108, and a 63-key extended-NEC remote table (ext00).
